title: Exploring the grafting copolymer of CNF-graft-PHEMA as a coating for packaging paper
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11521-11529
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08935B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Noverra Mardhatillah Nizardo, Naifa Inayah Hadiana, Chaulah Achyar, Aniek Sri Handayani, Azzah Dyah Pramata, Mukti Zainuddin, Annisa Rifathin
The paper coated with a modified cellulose nanofibril composite of CNF-graft-PHEMA/CA experienced an improvement in the hydrophobicity of the paper and thus could potentially be used as a coating for paper-based packaging.
